work.description: The act announces the Dutch hierarchy and the Costa Rica convention and creates cardinals. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF33-37) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF15350-15351 reads: RABITA JN CONSISTORIO SECRETO DIE Vl! MARTII ANNO MDCCCLIII Date note: Edition dated caption Habita in consistorio ..., retained in the selection; it is the only printed dating of the speech. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
